verdict.rationale: Better Auth's Device Authorization plugin implements an RFC 8628 code-issuance and approval flow, in which a human approves on a separate device. The homepage also claims 'agent delegation' for AI agents. Together these offer a glancing form of decoupled human approval an agent could use to obtain tokens, but nothing documents per-transaction confirmation. missing for 10: a CIBA or backchannel per-transaction approval flow, documentation of approval gating for sensitive agent actions, details of how agent delegation works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
